primary.carryTrial: separate side ladders and transverse members

deck.handlingBasis: Illustrative nominal square-corner HSS and plywood. Stock, feet, seams, finish, connector plates and fasteners require weighing.

splice.label: Truss splice
splice.connection: Mating module-end planes at the upper and lower chord. Design the shear transfer and the axial couple together.
splice.access: Trial insertion, wrench swing and extraction from the crawl-space side.

cross.label: Transverse tie seat
cross.connection: Transverse member terminates at a side-truss work point. Upper and lower ties restrain the two sides.
cross.access: Reserve a tool approach from inside the bay before fitting the walking surface.

shore.label: Body shore seat
shore.connection: Compression-only saddle under the lower chord. Paired landings reference the surveyed study, pending inspection.
shore.access: Record adjustment, inspection and removal envelope with the bus at normal ride height.

deck.label: Cassette carrier seat
deck.connection: A removable transverse carrier seats on the two side chords. Locate carriers at cassette ends independently of truss splices.
deck.access: Trial top removal and underside inspection with the adjacent cassette installed.
dependencies: carrier bearing, lateral restraint and retention

panel.label: Shell adapter
panel.connection: Keyed removable arm root and witness datum. Outer pickup positions follow the registered facet edges.
panel.access: Check reach, hand clearance, adjacent sheet removal and the DJ sightline.
dependencies: arm root and primary node demand

upperAudio.label: Upper audio receiver
upperAudio.connection: Paired empty receiver zones on the party-side upper chord. Adapter terminates at the selected manufacturer's approved fly frame.
upperAudio.access: Reserve rigging access, pin withdrawal, secondary retention and inspection sightlines.

lowerAudio.label: Lower audio receiver
lowerAudio.connection: Removable drop-frame and outside bearer transfer shelf load into two backbone elevations. The supported cabinet footprint can change.
lowerAudio.access: Trial cabinet loading, positive retention, service and shelf removal with a lightweight dummy.
dependencies: mass, centre of gravity and restraints
